outcome: Time from discharge to wound infections
cohort: 60 patients who developed SSIs after cesarean section (30 during the COVID-19 pandemic and 30 before)
finding: Although there was an increase in the frequency of deep incisional infections during the pandemic, post-cesarean section infections were not significantly affected by the pandemic in terms of clinical and laboratory features.
mod_finding: There was an increase in deep incisional infection rates after cesarean section during the COVID-19 pandemic, but this difference was not statistically significant.
